title: CloudSpace - Cloud Storage
summary: Secure cloud storage for photo backup, file sync & file sharing.
description:
Cloud Space gives you one secure place to store, backup, restore, sync and share everything that matters — photos, videos, documents, music and more. This cloud storage app for Android combines secure cloud storage, cloud backup, and online file storage so your files are always protected and available across your phone, tablet, and the web.

Free up space on your device while keeping an automatic, up-to-date copy of your files in the cloud. Reach your content from anywhere, restore files to Android, share folders and links in a few taps, and continue where you left off on any device.

WHY CLOUD SPACE:

- Secure cloud storage for Android with flexible plans that grow as your needs increase.
- Automatic cloud backup for photos, videos, documents, and other important files.
- Reliable file sync across devices for seamless access anywhere.
- Simple, fast, and secure cloud drive experience with an easy-to-use interface.

KEY FEATURES:

- Cloud storage app for photos, videos, documents, audio files, and folders.
- Automatic Android cloud backup app that continuously protects your latest files.
- Photo backup app, video backup app, and document backup app in one place.
- Secure file backup with automatic uploads and easy backup & restore functionality.
- Restore files to Android quickly when switching devices or recovering lost data.
- File sync across devices to keep your content updated everywhere.
- Built-in file manager to organize, search, rename, and move files.
- Cloud storage with vault to protect sensitive files in a private, secure space.

YOUR PRIVACY:

Your files are yours. Data is encrypted in transit, never sold to third parties, and you can request deletion of your data at any time. Cloud Space delivers secure cloud storage, secure cloud backup and reliable protection for your personal files.

FLEXIBLE PLANS:

Start with free cloud storage and upgrade anytime to a plan that matches your storage needs. Choose monthly or yearly subscriptions with extra storage space and better value as your library grows.

Download Cloud Space today and enjoy secure cloud storage, automatic file backup, and easy file restore whenever you need it.
